headline: Weak marginal-angle windswell — barely worth the paddle.
today: Under a foot and a half on a poor S angle for the inlet, with light cross-off early giving way to E onshore by afternoon. If you go, go at dawn on a log and keep expectations low. Mostly a skip.

daysToWatch.note: E swell finally swings to a good angle for the inlet, up to 2ft, but ENE cross-on wind is on it early. Marginal but the best-angled day of the week — worth a look.
S wind ramps to 17mph all day. Junky and cross, low priority.
Biggest at 2.4-2.9ft with WNW offshore to cross-off wind. Short period and marginal angle so it'll be soft, but the cleanest size window — morning is the play.
